explicit_source_layout.review: Reviewed actual RGBA flattened on gray. Six authored rows are clear; vertical bands follow their transparent gaps, with healing taller than the nominal grid. Preserve all declared cell-center anchors and all interior glows/sparks. Boundary removal is limited to alpha1 on the single outer pixel. No visible alpha may be cut.

processing.method: Explicit rectangles or exact grid extraction; common declared-center square and scale per row; accounted boundary cleanup when explicitly reviewed; Lanczos3 RGBA resampling; transparent padding; byte-copy atlas packing.
processing.bolt_orientation: Authored horizontal, pointing right; never flipped or rotated by this pipeline.

rows.anchor_policy: Explicit source centers; one radius and scale per row.
